about: Vulkan drivers DroidPlay for Windows offers per game (dm/android/desktop/vk_drivers.py). Each is a builder's own GitHub release asset, pinned by the zip's and the driver's SHA-256: the app downloads it on demand, checks both, and never runs anything from it on the computer. Changed by pull request, shipped with releases. tested rows are DroidPlay's own runs only. dm/android/tools/vk_catalog.py check compares each zip with the digest GitHub lists.

drivers.name: Mr. Purple Turnip T30

games.0100000011D90000: Brilliant Diamond: 60 fps in its language menu; Eterna City 57.7-58.2 fps on 2026-11-10 (15 on the phone's own driver)
games.0100000000010000: Super Mario Odyssey: the opening at 40 fps on 2026-11-08 (38 on the phone's own driver)

games.0100B1C0249B4000: Frostpunk: the Generator and the buildings draw, which the phone's own driver can't build; the city at 29.4 fps

games.0100000000010000: Super Mario Odyssey: the opening at 60 fps on 2026-11-08

games.0400C3F00006E000: Mario Kart World: the title, the menus and a Grand Prix race; the skinning shader that hangs the phone's own driver completes

games.0100000011D90000: Brilliant Diamond: 60 fps in its language menu

drivers.licence: No licence file in the builder's repository, and the patches aren't published; Mesa's core is MIT
drivers.notes: The builder lists the Adreno 6xx, 7xx and 8xx, with the 710 and 720 partly dropped. Names an Adreno 650 or 740 "PurpleVK-public Adreno (TM) …" and the Razr's 730 a 725.

drivers.name: faux123 Turnip 1.2.10

games.0100000011D90000: Brilliant Diamond: 60 fps in its language menu, after about 3 minutes building its pipelines at the first start with this driver
games.0100B1C0249B4000: Frostpunk: the Generator and the buildings draw, as on T30; the city at 29.5 fps

drivers.notes: The builder lists the Adreno 6xx, the 7xx including the 710, 720 and 722, and the 810, 825, 829, 830 and 840, and tested it on the 640, 650, 660, 722, 730, 740 and 830.

drivers.name: StevenMXZ Turnip Gen8 V39
drivers.licence: GPL-3.0 (the repository's build scripts); Mesa's core is MIT
drivers.notes: For the Adreno 8xx only (Gen8). Mesa 27.0 per the release's title (Turnip v27.0.0-R2). Experimental, as Adreno 8xx Turnip builds are: one has been seen to wedge a GPU until a reboot. Whether it has VK_EXT_mesh_shader isn't checked. On 2026-11-11 it also ran Brilliant Diamond (60 fps in its language menu) and Frostpunk (as faux123 does) on a Razr Plus 2023's Adreno 730, which the builder doesn't list: the catalog offers it for the 8xx only, where it hasn't been tested yet.
